items.problem: G1: CS0104 guidance was framed around UWP/WinUI XAML type collisions and was easy to miss for System.Net.Http versus Windows.Web.Http.
items.evidence: Turn 27 reported ambiguous HttpClient and HttpResponseMessage; turn 29 resolved them by fully qualifying Windows.Web.Http.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, `CS0104: 'LaunchActivatedEventArgs' is an ambiguous reference`, especially the final fully-qualify/remove-stale-using rule.
items.proposed_improvement: Generalize the existing final sentence to all same-simple-name namespace collisions, with System/Windows projections as a second example.
items.generalizes: Implicit usings in SDK-style projects commonly collide with retained Windows namespaces.
